units.text: INT. PICKLE BRINING CELLAR - DAY
Oak barrels stacked to the rafters.
A single bare bulb swings on a cord.
The smell is dill, vinegar and old secrets.
FELIX BRANDT, fifties, a deli owner in a stained apron and a bow tie he refuses to remove, stands guard over a barrel with both arms spread wide.
MABEL TOOMEY, thirties, a health inspector with a clipboard and a face like a closed door, taps her pen against the barrel lid.
SOL KAPLAN, sixties, Felix's brother-in-law, sits on an upturned crate eating a pickle with great concentration.
Open the barrel, Mr. Brandt.
units.name: MABEL

units.text: It's a pickle barrel. You've seen one. They're all the same.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Open it.
units.name: MABEL

units.text: Folks, nobody panic, the lady wants to see a pickle.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Sol chews.
Nobody moves.
The bulb sways.
Forty years. Forty years and she wants to see a pickle.
units.name: SOL

units.text: I heard a noise from this barrel when I came in.
units.name: MABEL

units.text: That's fermentation. It's alive. Like all of us.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: It said "Felix."
units.name: MABEL

units.text: Then it's a very friendly pickle.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Mabel reaches for the lid.
Felix steps in front of it.
Sol quietly slides his crate three feet to the left, to block the door.
Mabel, may I call you Mabel, the cellar is cold, your hands are cold, come upstairs, have a bagel.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Mr. Brandt, one thing at a time.
units.name: MABEL

units.text: I'll give you two bagels.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Three. She looks like a three.
units.name: SOL

units.text: I do not take bribes.
units.name: MABEL

units.text: Nobody said bribe. We said bagels.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: It's a family recipe, you understand!
units.name: FELIX

units.text: I understand a violation when I smell one!
units.name: MABEL

units.text: The lid thumps from inside.
All three stare at it.
Sol takes another bite.
Nice acoustics down here.
units.name: SOL

units.text: Felix puts a hand on the lid and presses down, smiling so hard his bow tie quivers.
Sol. The jar of the good relish. Upstairs. Now.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: She'll want it with mustard.
units.name: SOL

units.text: I want the barrel open.
units.name: MABEL

units.text: And I want a bigger deli. We don't always get.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: The lid thumps again.
Mabel, without taking her eyes off Felix, writes one word on her clipboard and underlines it twice.
